<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that matches the carbonyl‑ene intramolecular reaction described. Using the target molecule SMILES (C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1O)C(F)(F)F) we search the template catalog for templates that break a ketone and an alkene and form an aliphatic hydroxyl (and a ring). This will give us the template ID(s). Then we will apply the found template(s) to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1O)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyl"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)", "6-8 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
